utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Good afternoon. The representative of the Registry, would you please read the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. Case IT-02-61-A, the Prosecutor versus Miroslav Deronjic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Thank you very much. The appearances for the appellant.

utterances.speaker: MR. CVIJETIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Slobodan Cvijetic. I am Defence counsel for the accused Miroslav Deronjic, the appellant in this case. And sitting next to me is my colleague, Mr. Zecevic, also counsel for the accused Miroslav Deronjic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Deronjic, can you listen and understand us?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Excellency, yes, I can hear you very well and I can understand you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Appearances for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCKEON
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Senior appeals counsel Mark McKeon for the Prosecution, and I'm joined at our counsel table by our case manager, Lourdes Galicia. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Thank you very much. This Status Conference is called to see if there are any questions which the parties want to raise or which the appellant wants to raise personally. So I'll first give the floor to counsel for the appellant.

utterances.speaker: MR. CVIJETIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, there are no issues which we would like to raise at this Status Conference or to discuss here, so this would be a regular, standard conference, if I can say so.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Mr. Deronjic, is there something you want to raise personally?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, Your Excellency, I have nothing to raise today. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCKEON
utterances.text: No, Your Honour, there's nothing that we want to raise today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Well, then this Status Conference is adjourned. I only want to let you know that you can all have vacations during January, because we will not have -- I cannot tell you when the hearing will be, but you can -- you do not have to be available during January. The Status Conference is adjourned.
